trust_decision.summary: getRedirectURL decides whether the request Host is trusted for the OAuth2 callback URL: it is replaced by DashboardHost only when DashboardHost is non-empty and Host is not a reserved host. When DashboardHost is empty, Host passes through. The published commit does not change this logic. It only rewrites the comment to declare the empty-DashboardHost passthrough intentional.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the OAuth2 redirect_uri and an empty dashboard_host. getRedirectURL is the only function that builds that URL from Host and DashboardHost.

fix_sites.module_kind: handler helper; comment-only change, no code change for this advisory

fix_sites.entry_point: internal DispatchTask bus fed by ServiceSentinel cron

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Upstream documents the empty-DashboardHost passthrough as intended for dynamic or multi-domain deployments (model/config.go:50, fix.diff:11-15), and its own test requires it (cmd/dashboard/controller/oauth2_test.go:145-153). A solver can argue there is nothing to fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multi-domain or proxied deployments with an empty DashboardHost rely on the request Host being passed through to the OAuth2 callback. ReservedHosts must stay trusted. X-Forwarded-Proto must still upgrade the scheme to https.
